name: Infrastructure Security
description: Skills related to the security assessment of cloud, on-premises, and hybrid infrastructure. Covers cloud-native security (AWS, Azure, GCP), container and orchestration security, infrastructure-as-code review, and on-premises infrastructure assessment.

categories.name: AWS Security
categories.description: Amazon Web Services security assessment. Covers IAM, S3, VPC, Lambda, CloudTrail, and AWS-specific attack patterns and misconfigurations.

categories.name: Azure Security
categories.description: Microsoft Azure security assessment. Covers Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), storage accounts, networking, Azure Functions, and Azure-specific attack patterns and misconfigurations.

categories.name: GCP Security
categories.description: Google Cloud Platform security assessment. Covers IAM, GCS, VPC, Cloud Run functions (formerly Cloud Functions), and GCP-specific attack patterns and misconfigurations.

categories.name: Container Security
categories.description: Container and orchestration security. Covers Docker security, Kubernetes security, container escape techniques, image scanning, and runtime security.

categories.name: Infrastructure as Code Security
categories.description: Security review of infrastructure-as-code. Covers Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, and other IaC tools. Includes misconfiguration detection and policy-as-code evaluation.

categories.name: On-Premises Infrastructure
categories.description: On-premises infrastructure security assessment. Covers Active Directory, virtualization platforms, server hardening, backup systems, and hybrid cloud integration points.

categories.name: Identity & SaaS Security
categories.description: Security assessment of cross-platform identity and SaaS services. Covers identity federation and single sign-on (SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2.0), identity providers, Microsoft 365 and other SaaS tenant configuration, and SaaS security posture management.
